init_judge_ranker: create a JudgeRanker instance from a JudgeRankerConfig to load the SAMAudio judge model and processor
forward_judge_ranker: run the JudgeRanker forward pass with input audio, extracted audio, and descriptions to get ranking scores
load_judge_model: load a pretrained SAMAudioJudgeModel using from_pretrained with a checkpoint or model ID
load_judge_processor: load a pretrained SAMAudioJudgeProcessor using from_pretrained with a checkpoint or model ID
rank_audio_candidates: rank multiple audio candidates against descriptions using the JudgeRanker forward method with batched tensors
